_comment: Machine-readable projection of docs/tasks/task-283-race-index-job-mapping/findings.md. Neither the Go server nor the admin UI loads this at runtime; both assert their compiled tables against it in tests (task-283 design D-9). Adding a slot here without adding it to BOTH tables fails those tests, which is the point. Per-version `verified` is true only when every slot in that version is individually `verified: true`; a slot's `verified` mirrors the corresponding findings.md row's status column (`verified` -> true, anything else -> false). `jobId: null` means the numeric job id could not be established (class unverified, or the row itself is unestablished) -- never a guess. `class` matches the findings.md class column for that row; where findings.md used markdown emphasis purely for rendering (the three no-race versions), the emphasis markers are stripped but the wording is unchanged.

slots.note: No IDA export and no IDB for this version. The (1,0) slot is present in every candidate mapping the client could plausibly have used, so it is insensitive to the ambiguity, but it is not confirmed against a binary.

slots.note: CLogin::SendNewCharPacket 0x500545 encodes no race member and no sub-job member; the client cannot select or transmit any ordinal other than Explorer. (1,0) is shown here for cross-version display consistency, matching the canonical Explorer ordinal used on every later version.
